# Vecchio & Emara (1992) one-bay two-storey RC frame, monotonic lateral pushover:
# net lateral load [kN] against second-storey displacement [mm].
# Digitised (pixel-tracked at 600 dpi) from Fig. 11 of Guner & Vecchio,
# "Pushover Analysis of Shear-Critical Frames: Verification and Application",
# ACI Structural Journal 107(1), Jan-Feb 2010, pp. 72-83, which reproduces the
# experimental curve of Vecchio & Emara, "Shear Deformations in Reinforced
# Concrete Frames", ACI Structural Journal 89(1), 1992, pp. 46-56.
# Check on the digitisation: Guner & Vecchio quote the frame's experimental
# "total energy dissipated" as 44.4 kN.m; the area under the digitised loading
# branch to 155 mm is 44.8 kN.m (1% off), so that is the quantity they mean.
# The area between loading and unloading branches is 37.9 kN.m (6.9 recovered).
# Unloading reaches zero net load at 106 mm (residual displacement).
# Columns: displacement_mm  load_kN  branch (1 = loading to 155 mm, 2 = unloading to zero net load)
